record_schema.component_id: stable kebab-case id for this governance record
record_schema.owner_repo: canonical repository or downstream project that owns the implementation
record_schema.owner_path: repo-relative path, package, or documented fixture location for owner review
record_schema.contract_summary: short atomic description of the component contract
record_schema.source_refs: issue, doc, fixture, or PR references that define the contract
record_schema.upstream_prereqs: upstream gates or contracts required before downstream cutover
record_schema.allowed_variation: local differences that are explicitly permitted
record_schema.forbidden_variation: local differences that would fork or weaken the contract
record_schema.downstream_consumers: known consumers that must inspect this record before migration work
record_schema.known_drift: array of drift entries with classification from drift_classification_enum
record_schema.backflow_candidates: local ideas that may be proposed upstream but are not silently copied
record_schema.last_verified_at: RFC3339 timestamp for the fixture review
record_schema.last_checked_ref: git ref or issue ref used for this fixture review

records.contract_summary: Portable memory kernel owning durable schema, provenance, recall primitives, vector/FTS fallback behavior, event-ledger projection, and readiness diagnostics without product workflow dependencies.
upstream_prereqs: kernel_surface_v1 fixture remains the portable surface manifest
memory schema and recall tests stay in Tachi before downstream cutover
operator/product surfaces remain excluded from the portable bundle
allowed_variation: adapter vocabulary may rename retain/recall while preserving kernel save/search semantics
downstream products may add persona or domain policy outside the kernel boundary
forbidden_variation: copying GitHub, dispatch, ship, release, or PR lifecycle into the memory kernel contract
forking durable memory schema without an upstream record
weakening provenance, access history, or recall diagnostic evidence

known_drift.summary: Fixture explicitly excludes operator/product surfaces from the portable memory kernel.
